sources.source: United States Air Force Academy — The Building Years
sources.observed: Academy resided at temporary Lowry AFB, Denver, 1955 to 1958; permanently relocated August 1958.
sources.effect: Campus geography only, not exact 1956-58 varsity game venue/site.

sources.observed: 1955 Lowry Academy campus map identifies Building 863 Cadet Gymnasium and Building 867 Gymnasium Annex.
sources.effect: Evidence of two Lowry gym structures, no direct varsity home contest attribution.

sources.source: Air Force Academy Athletics — Cadet Gym
sources.observed: Permanent Academy Cadet Gymnasium completed in 1958; distinct physical building from Lowry Building 863.
sources.effect: Prohibits projecting permanent 1958 Cadet Gymnasium backward into 1956-58.

sources.source: Air Force Academy Athletics — 1956-57 MBB schedule
sources.observed: Accepted HOME games are retrospectively labeled USAFA, CO; other same-season non-home games have explicit Denver, CO.
sources.effect: Preserve raw schedule locality; USAFA, CO is not physical venue/city proof during Lowry era.

sources.source: Air Force Academy Athletics — 1957-58 MBB schedule
sources.observed: Historic HOME queue records show USAFA, CO without verified 1957-58 venue.
sources.effect: No independent era-specific gym or city identified.

sources.observed: Series table says 1957 Dec. 18 at 'El Paso, Colo.' Drake win 74-69.
sources.effect: Affirmative game-specific conflicting location notation; cannot claim uniform Lowry Denver for all 19.

sources.source: Air Force Academy 2020 game notes (official target)
sources.observed: Target reciprocal series lists 12/18/57 location USAFA, Drake 74-69.
sources.effect: USAFA is ambiguous institutional label, not independent address or facility.

sources.observed: One 1957-12-18 game vs Drake listed at 'Cadet Gymnasium'; site has incomplete 9-game 1957-58 log and no contemporary first-party citation.
sources.effect: Venue name may refer to Lowry Building 863 or erroneous later campus facility backfill; not enough to assign building.

sources.observed: 1940s games against a team called Lowry Air Force Base predate USAFA intercollegiate program; different basketball identity.
sources.effect: Do not use 1940s Lowry team site or home record as reciprocal evidence for USAFA 1956-58.

settled_conclusions: The 1955 Lowry Academy campus did have a named Cadet Gymnasium, Building 863, physically distinct from the Academy's permanent-campus Cadet Gymnasium completed in 1958.
The 1956-58 institutional headquarters were in the Denver area, but institutional headquarters do not alone establish a HOME game's physical site.
The accepted 19 H/A/N HOME classifications are unchanged.

A retrospective official Drake record for 1957-12-18 says 'El Paso, Colo.' while the target uses USAFA and a secondary site uses Cadet Gymnasium; evidence does not safely establish that game's geography.
No game in this tranche has sufficient exact-site/era facility evidence to close the physical venue and city/state with the standard of proof required.
prohibited_inferences: Do not assign Lowry Building 863 to all 19 solely from facility existence and campus location.
Do not conflate pre-1958 Lowry Building 863 Cadet Gymnasium and 1958 Colorado Springs permanent Cadet Gymnasium.
Do not treat El Paso, Colo. as an exact building or silently normalize it to Colorado Springs without corroboration.
Do not label these 19 RESEARCHED_UNRESOLVED_HOME_LOCATION without exact protected-main owner-authority registry entries.
Do not reopen accepted 1958-59+ HOME chronology or H/A/N to force a matching venue.
